title: SignalCubeEdgesRow
description: Per-window call statistics of one caller→callee service pair, built from trace span pairs (03 §3.2). Written by Signalyth; depends on alert windows.

caller.description: Calling service A: service of the parent span (or of the client-like span wrapping the call).

callee.description: Called service B ≠ caller: service of the child entry span.

window.description: Alert window (alert.windows) the call pairs are counted in.

calls.description: Number of parent→child call pairs in the window. Rows with calls = 0 are not written, so a row always has calls ≥ 1. Consumers read a (caller, callee) pair that has a row in one window and none in the other as calls = 0 in the window without a row.

error_rate.description: Pairs where the child or its client span has status = error, divided by calls; in [0, 1].

p50_caller_ms.description: Median client-observed duration (client-like span) in ms; null when no client span; null below traces.min_spans_per_quantile samples.

p99_caller_ms.description: p99 client-observed duration (client-like span) in ms; null when no client span; null below traces.min_spans_per_quantile samples.

p50_callee_ms.description: Median server-side duration (child entry span) in ms; null below traces.min_spans_per_quantile samples.

p99_callee_ms.description: p99 server-side duration (child entry span) in ms; null below traces.min_spans_per_quantile samples.

p50_gap_ms.description: Median per-pair gap (client duration − child duration) in ms; null when no client span; null below traces.min_spans_per_quantile samples.

p99_gap_ms.description: p99 per-pair gap (client duration − child duration) in ms; null when no client span; null below traces.min_spans_per_quantile samples.
